forum.title: Info for ST87M01
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello Shubham08,

Yes, ST87M01 module is pre-programmed by STMicroelectronics during the manufacturing process with a default firmware version. However, you may need to update this firmware to a newer version to incorporate functional improvements, additional features, or security enhancements.

The eval kit can be directly connected to the PC GUI, using a standard USB cable.

Regards,

Didier

forum.author: Shubham08

scraped_replies.html:
Hello Shubham08,

ST87M01 is a LTE-NBIOT platform (it should not be confused with LTE CAT-M1). It is enough to send 2Kb of data, but keep in mind that NBIOT is a technology offering a lower date rate (compared to LTE CAT-M1), but achieving a longer range, using less energy and less expensive. This is not the same targeted applications.

You must check with the operators if they propose NBIOT coverage in your country, and what is the best SIM with a data plan adapted to your needs.

For your project, the eSIM will be connected externally (we support also classic SIM) to the ST87M01.

ST guarantees a 15 years availability.

On st.com, you will find a startup package : https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-st87mgui.html

 

Please open a separate topic for ST4SI2M0020TPIFW to get answer from the experts (different team).
